name: Single Product Customizer For WooCommerce
author: WooXperto

sections.description:
Enhance WooCommerce product page with variations table, AJAX add-to-cart, quantity controls, custom tab and more.. for a better shopping experience.
Take full control of your WooCommerce single product pages with the Single Product Customizer For WooCommerce plugin. Whether you’re looking to enhance the design, improve user experience, or boost conversions — this powerful tool lets you customize every section of your product page effortlessly.

🖥️Live Demo: View Demo

📝Documentation View Doc

🚀Try Pro Try Pro Version

✨ Key Features:

🔢 Quantity Control Enhancements

✔️ Enable Plus/Minus Buttons: Improve user interaction with plus/minus buttons for quantity selection.
✔️ Enable Min/Max Quantity Limits (Pro): Set global or product-specific minimum and maximum quantity limits. Check Demo
✔️ Custom Validation Messages (Pro): Show personalized messages for min/max quantity violations.
✔️ Set Quantity Step (Pro): Define step intervals (e.g., 2, 5) for quantity input.

Watch Video

🛒 Cart and Button Customization

✔️ Enable Plus/Minus Buttons: Improve user interaction with plus/minus buttons for quantity selection.
✔️ Change “Add to Cart” Button Text: Customize the default cart button label. [Check Demo](https://wsppc.wooxperto.com/product/single-product-meta-remove/
✔️ Hide Add to Cart Button: Option to remove the add to cart button entirely.
✔️ Enable Ajax Add to Cart (Pro): Faster, smoother cart actions without page reloads.

Watch Video

📦 Product Availability Customization

✔️ Out of Stock Text: Replace default out-of-stock text with your own.
✔️ On Backorder Text: Display custom messages when a product is on backorder. Check Demo

Watch Video

🏷️ Product Badges & Pricing

✔️ Change Sale Badge Text: Replace the “Sale!” badge with your own custom message.Check Demo
✔️ Hide Price: Temporarily hide product prices if needed.

Watch Video

🧹 Remove Product Meta
✔️ Remove Product Meta
✔️ Remove Related Product Section
✔️ Remove Product Ratings
✔️ Hide Short Description

⚙️ Advanced Customization Options (Pro):

✔️ Enable Category-Based Customization
✔️ Enable Product-Based Customization

Watch Video

✍🏻 Custom Messages:

✔️ Enable Custom Message Display Show a personalized message like “Anything you can show in product details page in different possition”.Check Demo
✔️ Select Display Location: Choose where the custom message should appear on the product page.

Watch Video

📃 Tab and Layout Customization:

✔️ Enable Custom Tabs (Pro): Add extra content using new tabs. Check Demo
✔️ Change Default Tab Labels (Pro): Customize “Description”, “Additional Information”, and “Reviews” tab texts.
✔️ Enable Additional Content (Pro): Include extra informational sections.
✔️ Move Image Section to Right Side (Pro): Move Image Section to Right Side (Pro): Change the product image layout to suit your design.

Watch Video

🎨 Variation Switcher and Table:

✔️ Enable Variation Switcher: Modern switcher for product variations.
✔️ Show Variation Table: Display a clean table of variations at your chosen location. Check Demo

✔️ Change “Reset Variation” Text: Replace the default variation reset button text.
✔️ Customize Related & Upsell Product Titles: Replace default titles like “Related Products” or “You May Also Like”.
✔️ Display Related Product Categories in Grid View (Pro)

Watch Video
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files:
    • Download the plugin ZIP file.
    • Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now.”
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • After installation, click “Activate Plugin.”
  3. Install Required Plugins:
    • Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the Plugin:
    • Go to Dashboard > WooCommerce > Products to customize the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. Can i change add to cart button text?

    • yes, you can change add to cart button text.

  2. Can I hide product price?

    • Yes, you can easily hide product price.

  3. Can I add custom message at single product page ?

    • Yes, you can add cusotm message to single product page.

  4. Can I show/hide plus minus button?

    • Yes, you can show or hide plus minus as needed.
